priorityList: Apply Arcane Intellect and cast Mirror Image before combat begins.
Activate Combustion while finishing a cast (Scorch, Fireball, Meteor, or Flamestrike) when your major cooldowns are ready.
Use offensive Trinkets, Racials, and Potions while Combustion is active, ideally with more than 6 seconds remaining.
Cast Meteor during Combustion if it has more than 2 seconds remaining, or when 4+ targets are present to sync with Combustion.
Spend Hot Streak procs on Flamestrike if there are 4 or more targets present.
Spend Hot Streak procs on Pyroblast if there are fewer than 4 targets present.
Spend Pyroclasm procs on Flamestrike (4+ targets) or Pyroblast (fewer than 4 targets) when Combustion is down or at 2 stacks of the buff.
During Hyperthermia procs, spam Flamestrike if 4+ targets are present, otherwise spam Pyroblast.
Use Scorch as your filler and for Heating Up generation if targets are below 30% health (with Scald) or if 4+ targets are present during Combustion.
Use Fire Blast off-GCD to convert Heating Up into Hot Streak, prioritizing use during Combustion or when a hard-cast spell is mid-flight.
Use Scorch whenever Heat Shimmer is active.
Cast Fireball as your primary filler to generate Heating Up when not in Scorch execute range.
If Firestarter is talented and the target is above 90% health, prioritize Pyroblast to consume Hot Streaks.
Prioritize hard-casting Flamestrike over Fireball if you have a Pyroclasm proc and Combustion is not active.
